caption: The Bottom, The Bottom
composition: Crater village and the dark mass of Mount Scenery at dusk · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the road just above The Bottom, small houses with red roofs sit in the green crater and Mount Scenery rises behind them. The stepped trail most visitors use starts in Windwardside, so this is the village view, not that trailhead and not the closed summit platform. It is clear and warm, about 27.9°C, with wind near 22.8 km/h. Sunset was 18:06 America/Kralendijk, so 18:19 is dusk, about thirteen minutes after sunset.
